summary.text: Jackie Haas, a Republican, represents the 79th District in the Illinois House of Representatives, a seat she has held since December 2020.

paragraphs.text: According to the General Assembly biography, she was raised in Momence and earned a bachelor's degree in social work from Valparaiso University and a master's in social work from the University of Illinois Chicago.
The biography lists her as a former social worker at Riverside Medical Center and says she lives in Bourbonnais with her husband.
